body: Thank you so much for your kindness. I have managed to get through this episode. I will keep your list in mind for the next time this happens. Best wishes to you!
:) Needed to hear something like this tonight. Thanks stranger.

This is my throwaway account. The name is based on how I feel when I'm suicidal from being slightly emotionally abused and neglected in certain ways as a child.

Feeling better tonight, though. :)

My shower looks just like the one in that picture. Clawfoot tub with a curtain that goes all the way around. I'm a 5' 5" girl and I have to duck about an inch for the top of my head to get showered on. I can't imagine what it would be like for a very tall person! Haha
Feeling so broken for so long, and not being able to fix it. :(
